titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 秦昭襄王五十三年: notes

div.interp: The fifty-third year of King Zhaoxiang of Qin, 254 BC.
来宾: came as guests, that is, in submission.
The nineteenth year of Duke Qing of Lu, 254 BC.
徐州: the Suoyin, citing the Shuowen's 䣄, "a lower town of Zhu, east of Lu", gives the pronunciation of the character as that of 舒, shu; hence Shuzhou.
The twelfth year of King Xiaocheng of Zhao, 254 BC.
廥 is supplied from the three-commentary edition, which reads 邯郸廥烧; Xu Guang: a stable; the Suoyin: a store of hay and straw, destroyed by fire.
